# mimecast_address_alteration_sets (Data Source)

Read Address Alteration Sets through the legacy POST-style read endpoint. Mutation is excluded because the API has no safe delete lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_address_alteration_sets" "all" {
  depth = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `depth` (Number) Folder recursion depth requested from Mimecast. Defaults to 1.
- `folder_id` (String) Optional set ID to scope the read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Address Alteration Set inventory ID.
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Set description.
- `folder_count` (Number) Number of child sets.
- `id` (String) Address Alteration Set ID.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent set ID.
- `source` (String) Set source, such as cloud or ldap.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users in the set.
